name: obsidian-cli
title_zh: 在 Obsidian 库里搜、写、改、查，不用开编辑
tagline_zh: 笔记都在 Obsidian 里，AI 却看不见。装上它 agent 能直接读写笔记、搜索、改属性和任务——作者就是 Obsidian 的 CEO。
tagline_en: Drive your Obsidian vault from the CLI — read, create, search notes and manage tasks and properties. Built by kepano, Obsidian's own creator.
desc_en: Interact with Obsidian vaults using the Obsidian CLI to read, create, search, and manage notes, tasks, properties, and more. Also supports plugin and theme development with commands to reload plugins, run JavaScript, capture errors, take screenshots, and inspect the DOM. Use when the user asks to interact with their Obsidian vault, manage notes, search vault content, perform vault operations from
why_zh: 一手权威：没人比作者更懂这个库的数据模型，比任何第三方封装都可靠。
why_en: Written by Obsidian's CEO — nobody knows the vault data model better; your agent can finally read and write your second brain properly.
limit_zh: 要装 obsidian 命令行，而且 Obsidian 必须开着，关掉就全断。命令清单以 obsidian help 为准，这里只列了常用几条。不写 vault= 时动的是最近聚焦的那个库。
limit_en: Requires the obsidian CLI and a running Obsidian instance; close the app and everything stops. The command list here is partial, with `obsidian help` as the authority. Without vault=, commands act on whichever vault was focused last.
title_en: Search, write, edit your Obsidian vault from the CLI
